_dynamics_notes: Activity-based (eq 3-8): C=20 pF, ENa 55, ESynE -10, gSyn 10 nS, Vth -50, Vmax 0, d=1.0. Table A.2: gLeak 4.5 (RG) / 2.8 (IN,CIN) / 1.6 (PF,MN); gNaP 4.5 (RG) / 0.5 (PF) / 0.3 (MN) - PF and MN sub-rhythmogenic, rhythm defined by RG-F (RG-E tonic when uncoupled). ESynI -75 (IN,CIN) / -70 (PF,MN); ELeak -62.5 / -60 / -64 / -64. NaP: m_inf instant (V+40)/6; h_inf (V+45)/4; tau_h(V) = 320 + 320/cosh((V+35)/15) ms (floor 320 ms). TRAP: keep our fixed tau_h = 350 ms (params.py rg_nap_h=0.35) - collapsing tau_h(V) quenches half-centers. ALL afferent input is excitatory (s_j in ISynE bracket, eq 7).
_groundloss_mechanism: Discussion + Figs 5/7/8: (1) hole -> hyperextension -> flexor length beyond 0.9*lmax -> k_l_F fires RG-F early -> foot pulled out; (2) contralateral stance maintained by extensor force feedback (k_f_E) + crossed V3 -> contra IN-E -> contra RG-F suppression (with the ipsilateral flexor center's reciprocal contribution, their Fig 8); (3) without these loops walking fails after ground loss (Appendix C, Movies 6/7); (4) nullcline geometry change, not amplitude (Fig 7, Appendix D). NOTE: NO crossed flexor-EXCITATORY edge exists in this paper - that edge's sources are Shevtsova 2026 Table 1 (V3-F -> c-RG-F 0.03) and Rybak 2015 Fig 7A (CINe-F).
_optimization: 13 params by CMA-ES on randomized +/-2 cm belt levels: 7 PF->MN weights + {k_v_F, k_l_F, k_f_E, tau_v, tau_l, tau_f}; cost = long walking + low muscle activity + falling penalty (exact formula not extracted - see shinohara_draft.md).
